messages.text: Reconcile package PKG-4. Drawing D-101 revision C arrived after revision B was approved for construction, but C is only for review. A transmittal draft points to B, and an RFI still references A. Prepare the current register and exact questions without issuing documents.
C is the latest receipt; ENG-7 approved only B for construction. No current-use direction after C is supplied. D-102 is missing, S-4 awaits review of C, and RFI-8 still references A.
Keep the original references. Give the engineer exact questions and show why the Site team transmittal is held.

The private package includes the two-document register, three-revision history, S-4 and overdue RFI-8 follow-ups, and T-9/T1's exact B manifest. T-9 remains held for current-use clarification, recipient permission and issue authorization. No engineering approval, issue, EDMS change or contact was performed.

report.title: PKG-4 revision register and transmittal draft
report.summary: The register shows C as latest received and B as the last explicitly construction-approved revision, with supersession and continued-use uncertainty exposed. The package asks the engineer to resolve applicability, corrects no approval itself, and holds the transmittal for revision and recipient review.

items.title: Current-revision and authorized-use document register
items.summary: D-101: latest receipt C; historical construction approval B (ENG-7); current use unresolved. D-102: no receipt or file supplied. Engineer must clarify C's effect on B and provide D-102 evidence.

items.title: Submittal and RFI follow-up package with exact revision links
items.summary: S-4 references C and awaits Project engineer's review, due October 5. RFI-8 still references A; its October 1 deadline passed unanswered. Ask whether its original question remains applicable to B or C without rewriting A.

items.title: Draft transmittal manifest with intended purpose and permitted recipients
items.summary: T-9/T1 proposes D101-B for Site team for construction. Hold for current-use uncertainty, missing recipient-access evidence and missing exact-draft issue authorization; do not substitute C.

items.title: Supersession impact and missing-review handoff
items.summary: Retain D-101, D-102, S-4, RFI-8 and T-9 in the private handoff. No explicit supersession is supplied. Engineering, Information owner and Document controller retain their separate decisions; no issue or external action occurred.
